recipe.visualDefinition: A clean studio portrait of three individuals (two men flanking a woman) against a vibrant blue textured wall, featuring a high-contrast graphic footer with a glossy 3D emblem and bold sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing of the central figure by two taller males
Contrast between the organic studio lighting on subjects and the flat black footer bar
Color harmony between the blue background and the blue-toned glossy emblem
Visual weight balanced by the large logo on the left and bold text on the right
coreInvariants: Solid black footer bar across the bottom 20% of the frame
Vibrant cerulean blue background with subtle vignette
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned mid-thigh up, centered horizontally, filling the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy blue oval emblem in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down to the bright emblem, and sweeps right across the bold footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blue space above the subjects' heads to allow for vertical breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue background providing a cool, energetic atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black footer bar creating a stable base for white text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and silver highlights on the emblem and text for readability.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high-value skin tones and bright highlights on clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral '3' with a flat top and open curve

composition.position: Bottom right corner within the black bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script-style logo emblem paired with a rigid, modern geometric sans-serif for information.
graphicDevices: Glossy 3D oval emblem with chrome beveling

avoid: Drop shadows on the footer text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern authority of the original text.
Provides a similar open geometric feel with clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three smiling young adults (two men in jackets/suits, one woman in a denim vest) against a textured blue wall. Leave the bottom 20% of the image empty for a black overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black bar at the bottom. Place a glossy, chrome-beveled blue oval emblem on the left side of the bar, and right-aligned bold white geometric sans-serif text on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly white against the black bar?
Does the blue background have a slight vignette effect?
Is the emblem rendered with 3D depth and highlights?
Are the subjects lit with soft, professional studio lighting?

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the trio
Ensure the black bar is perfectly horizontal
Verify the 3D effect on the emblem is consistent with lighting
Confirm the font weight is sufficiently bold for display
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Trio Portrait + Textured Color Background + Black Footer Bar + Glossy Emblem + Bold Geometric Sans-Serif
